title: pm-dispatch(mailbox): epic seats cannot be rung — mailbox-open refuses `epic:` seat keys and the fleet roster has no epic rows
body:
domain:skills#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc

Carries item ③ of #28675 (epic seats get mailboxes); #28675 keeps items ①②④⑤, landing in PR #28716.
Filing gate: ② an in-scope item of in-flight work #28675 that its PR could not carry within the claim's file surface (dev report 6559765410, `open_questions` 1). Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:skills`, `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` (`seatKey`), `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` (seat rows), plus one line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "epic mailbox" → only #28675; "epic seat roster" → none.
reach: every epic PM seat. Measured on 2026-11-01 (#28675 body): `epic:#27293#1`, `epic:#28130#1` and `epic:#26676#1` dispatch every `pm:epic` card, but have no roster row and no mailbox, so no seat can ring them; triage's "take #28591 first" sat on the card instead.

## Measured by the #28675 dev

- `mailbox-open.mjs` `seatKey` refuses an `epic:` seat spelling, so an epic seat cannot open a mailbox.
- `fleet-roster.mjs` lists no epic seats, so the roster's mailbox column cannot show one.

## Wanted

- `mailbox-open.mjs --seat 'epic:#N#K'` opens a mailbox (branch slug and `Mailbox-of:` line follow the lane rules).
- The roster reads epic seats: either a row per open `pm:epic` parent that names a session, or a `Mailbox:` line on the epic card body that the roster reads.
- One rules line in 〈信箱 PR〉 says an epic seat opens a mailbox like any seat (after #28675's table lands, which this card builds on).

Blocked-by: #28675
